title: Light Egyptian Flaxseed Frittata
description: A fresh and crumbly Egyptian dish featuring flaxseed, perfect for a high-protein brunch, made with stir-fry ingredients and a blend of spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, ground flaxseed, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and tomato to the skillet and stir-fry until the vegetables are tender.
In a greased 9-inch pie plate, arrange the cooked vegetables in the bottom of the plate.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables and sprinkle with feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Bake the frittata for 25-30 minutes or until the eggs are set and the edges are golden brown.
Remove the frittata from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
